import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple:
    """
    Visualize the distribution of stock closing prices using a box plot and a histogram
    within a single figure.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple
        (boxplot_ax, histogram_ax)
    """
    if df is None:
        df = pd.DataFrame()

    # Prefer a standard closing-price column if available; otherwise fall back gracefully.
    close_col = None
    preferred_columns = [
        "Close",
        "close",
        "Closing Price",
        "closing price",
        "Adj Close",
        "AdjClose",
    ]
    for col in preferred_columns:
        if col in df.columns:
            close_col = col
            break

    if close_col is None:
        numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns.tolist()
        if numeric_cols:
            close_col = numeric_cols[0]
        elif len(df.columns) > 0:
            close_col = df.columns[0]

    prices = pd.Series(dtype=float) if close_col is None else pd.to_numeric(df[close_col], errors="coerce").dropna()

    fig, (box_ax, hist_ax) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

    if prices.empty:
        box_ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No data available", ha="center", va="center")
        hist_ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No data available", ha="center", va="center")
    else:
        sns.boxplot(x=prices, ax=box_ax, color="skyblue")
        sns.histplot(prices, ax=hist_ax, bins="auto", color="steelblue", kde=False)

    box_ax.set_title("Box Plot of Closing Prices")
    box_ax.set_xlabel("Closing Prices")
    box_ax.set_ylabel("")

    hist_ax.set_title("Histogram of Closing Prices")
    hist_ax.set_xlabel("Closing Prices")
    hist_ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return box_ax, hist_ax
